clues: This small city sits in the north of Venezuela. It serves as the chief town of its district.
The sun shines here all year, with rain on just 60 days. The air stays warm but feels dry, not sticky.
This town was founded in 1690. Its past is long, and its town roots run deep.
A shrine here is known for claimed sights of the Virgin Mary. Folks come here to pray at this shrine.
This city is one stop on the Ezequiel Zamora mass transport system. That big name is a strong clue that helps you find the spot.
